subcategory_text: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-11, PM-30, RA-07, SA-09, SR-05
CRI Profile v2.0: GV.OC-05, GV.OC-05.01, GV.OC-05.02, GV.OC-05.03, GV.OC-05.04
implementation_examples: Create an inventory of the organization's dependencies on external resources (e.g., facilities, cloud-based hosting providers) and their relationships to organizational assets and business functions
Identify and document external dependencies that are potential points of failure for the organization's critical capabilities and services, and share that information with appropriate personnel
assessment_objectives: Determine whether outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated.

Determine whether activities are conducted to create an inventory of the organization's dependencies on external resources (e.g., facilities, cloud-based hosting providers) and their relationships to organizational assets and business functions.

Determine whether activities are conducted to identify and document external dependencies that are potential points of failure for the organization's critical capabilities and services, and share that information with appropriate personnel.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
